summary: Central Puerto S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K that it and wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired treasury shares under Article 64 of Argentina's Capital Markets Law. On 10/08/2026, CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average AR$2,032.42, totaling AR$243,891,141. Proener bought 30,000 ADRs on the NYSE (300,000 shares equivalent) at USD12.64, totaling USD379,280.43. Both trades settled 10/09/2026 and stayed under 25% of the prior 90 business-day average daily volume. Watch buyback pace and ADR ratio arbitrage.
